description:

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP Technical Consultant (ABAP)
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000-$125,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Technical Consultant (ABAP) with strong S/4HANA expertise to design, develop, and support custom enhancements, integrations, and reports within large enterprise SAP landscapes. This role spans the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, hands-on coding, unit testing, performance tuning, and post-go-live support in close collaboration with functional consultants and business stakeholders. • Solid experience building OData services and integrating with Fiori applications.

• Hands-on experience with enhancement frameworks (BADIs, user exits, implicit/explicit enhancements).

• Strong experience with integration technologies (IDoc, RFC, BAPI, Web Services).

• Solid understanding of SAP module data structures, including FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP, depending on the project area.

• Experience with performance tuning tools (SAT, ST05) and HANA diagnostic tools.

• Familiarity with SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, and SAP transport management.

• Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with S/4HANA system conversions or greenfield implementations.

• Exposure to SAP BTP, ABAP RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model), or steampunk.

• Hands-on experience with Fiori/UI5 development.

• Familiarity with SAP CPI / Integration Suite.

• SAP-certified ABAP developer credentials.

title: Basispsycholoog - SGGZ - Thuiswerken
description:
Werk volledig remote, ook vanuit het buitenland
Ben jij een ervaren basispsycholoog die zelfstandig kan werken, verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen en energie krijgt van specialistische GGZ? Heb je al minimaal twee jaar vlieguren gemaakt binnen de SGGZ en wil je jouw expertise inzetten binnen een innovatieve, volledig digitale behandelomgeving?
Dan is Beterggz mogelijk een mooie volgende stap voor jou.
Wij zoeken proactieve basispsychologen die online behandelen serieus nemen. Professionals die digitaal vaardig zijn, stevig in hun rol staan en ook op afstand een sterke behandelrelatie kunnen opbouwen.
Over Beterggz
Beterggz is een online aanbieder van specialistische GGZ. Wij bieden landelijk poliklinische behandelingen aan cliënten met uiteenlopende en complexe zorgvragen.
Ons team bestaat uit psychologen, artsen, psychiaters en andere betrokken professionals. We werken digitaal, multidisciplinair en met korte lijnen. Onze missie is helder: kwalitatief goede GGZ toegankelijker maken, wachtlijsten verkorten en zorg slimmer organiseren.
Omdat wij volledig online werken, maakt het minder uit waar je zit. Of je nu vanuit Nederland werkt of vanuit het buitenland, zolang de kwaliteit, continuïteit en professionaliteit op orde zijn.
Requirements
Wat ga je doen?
Als online basispsycholoog behandel je cliënten binnen de specialistische GGZ. Je voert online behandelgesprekken, doet psychodiagnostiek, stelt samen met collega’s behandelplannen op en bewaakt de voortgang van de behandeling.
Je werkt zelfstandig, maar niet geïsoleerd. Je maakt onderdeel uit van een digitaal multidisciplinair team waarin je afstemt met regiebehandelaren, psychiaters en collega-psychologen. Ook denk je actief mee over de kwaliteit van onze zorg, kennisdeling en de verdere ontwikkeling van digitale behandelprocessen.
De functie vraagt om iemand die overzicht houdt, zorgvuldig rapporteert, risico’s tijdig signaleert en professioneel blijft handelen bij complexe zorgvragen.
Wie zoeken wij?
Wij zoeken geen starter, maar een zelfstandige basispsycholoog met minimaal twee jaar ervaring binnen de SGGZ. Je hebt een afgeronde master Psychologie, beschikt over een LOGO-verklaring en hebt aantoonbare scholing in Cognitieve Gedragstherapie, CGT.
Je bent gewend om professioneel en gestructureerd te werken, communiceert helder en voelt je prettig in een digitale werkomgeving. Omdat je volledig online werkt, beschik je over eigen apparatuur en een rustige, veilige en professionele thuiswerkplek.
Ervaring of scholing in ACT, EMDR en schematherapie vinden wij waardevol. Dit is geen harde eis, maar wel een duidelijke pre. Datzelfde geldt voor ervaring met persoonlijkheidsproblematiek en andere complexe zorgvragen binnen de SGGZ.
Verder is het belangrijk dat je uitstekend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft. Engels kunnen spreken is mooi meegenomen.
Waarom Beterggz?
Bij Beterggz werk je volledig remote, met veel flexibiliteit in waar en wanneer je werkt. Je kunt dus ook vanuit het buitenland werken, zolang je professioneel bereikbaar bent en goede online zorg kunt leveren.
We werken op ZZP-basis met een uurtarief van €70 per uur. Het aantal uren stemmen we samen af en starten kan op korte termijn.
Je komt terecht in een snelgroeiende, digitale GGZ-organisatie met korte lijnen, veel vertrouwen en ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Je krijgt de kans om inhoudelijk sterk werk te doen én mee te bouwen aan een moderne manier van GGZ-zorg leveren.
Interesse?
Lijkt het je interessant om als online basispsycholoog bij Beterggz aan de slag te gaan?
Stuur je motivatie en CV naar:

Bij voldoende geschikte kandidaten sluiten wij de vacature.
Een VOG-verklaring maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.

title: Virtual Medical Receptionist
description:
Virtual Medical Receptionist
Remote | Neurology Facility | 40 Hours/Week | $5-$6/hour
Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and highly organized Virtual Medical Receptionist to support our busy US-based Neurology clinic. This role requires excellent communication skills, strong multitasking abilities, and experience working in a fast-paced healthcare environment.
The ideal candidate can effectively manage competing priorities, provide exceptional patient support, and maintain accuracy while handling a high volume of calls, referrals, and administrative tasks.
Key Responsibilities
Appointment Scheduling

• Coordinate and schedule patient appointments accurately and efficiently.

• Manage appointment confirmations, reschedules, and cancellations.

• Maintain provider schedules and optimize appointment availability.

Prior Authorization (Medication)

• Process medication prior authorization requests.

• Communicate with insurance companies, pharmacies, providers, and patients regarding authorization status.

• Follow up on outstanding requests to ensure timely patient care.

Insurance Verification

• Verify patient insurance eligibility, coverage, and benefits prior to appointments.

• Document insurance information accurately within the EMR system.

• Identify and communicate any coverage limitations or issues.

Referral Handling

• Receive, process, and track incoming and outgoing patient referrals.

• Coordinate with referring providers, specialists, and insurance companies as needed.

• Ensure referral documentation is complete, accurate, and properly attached to patient records.

• Follow up on pending referrals to help facilitate continuity of care.

Patient Communication

• Answer inbound calls professionally and courteously.

• Respond to patient inquiries, appointment requests, and administrative concerns.

• Maintain excellent customer service while supporting a high call volume clinic environment.

Required Skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong organizational and time-management abilities.

• Ability to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Ability to work independently while maintaining professionalism and accountability.

• Comfortable handling high call volumes and multiple administrative responsibilities simultaneously.

Qualifications

• Minimum of 1 year of experience as a Virtual Medical Assistant supporting a US-based clinic.

• Experience with appointment scheduling, insurance verification, and patient communication.

• Familiarity with healthcare workflows, medical terminology, and EMR systems.

• Experience managing referrals and coordinating patient care is preferred.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

• Experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW) .

• Previous experience supporting a Neurology practice .

• Experience working in a busy clinic environment with high patient and call volumes .

This position is ideal for a Virtual Medical Assistant who thrives in a fast-paced healthcare setting, can confidently manage a high volume of patient interactions, and is committed to providing outstanding support to both patients and providers.

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) - Frankfurt
description:
Du hast erste Vertriebserfahrung und willst jetzt richtig loslegen? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturierteres Onboarding, dein eigenes Gebiet, kurze Sales-Cycles und ein Team, das dich weiterentwickelt.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70% weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Outbound-Anteil (Kaltakquise, Walk-ins, eigene Terminierung).

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert und organisiert.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior- über Senior- und bis hin zu Führungsrollen..

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

You'll see how it works in the real world, find where it breaks, and help decide what gets fixed first.

This is an operations role with a strong product lens. You'll work with the product manager, engineering, design, and data teams to make sure the receipt scanning experience is accurate, fair, and hard to abuse. Your work will feed directly into what the team builds next. If you like finding patterns in messy real-world data and turning them into clear recommendations, this role is for you.

What You'll Do:

Receipt Quality & Validation Operations

• Own the day-to-day quality of receipt scanning submissions. Review submissions against validation rules, make approve/reject decisions, and apply them consistently.

• Spot edge cases the current system misses, such as unusual receipt formats, retailer-specific quirks, duplicates, and signs of abuse. Document them clearly so the team can handle them at scale.

Product Feedback & Prioritization

• Turn what you see in submissions into actionable feedback for engineering: clear bug reports, reproducible examples, and suggested improvements to extraction and validation logic.

• Keep a prioritized list of what needs improvement and why. Rank it by customer impact, fraud risk, and operational cost, and help the product manager bring it into planning.

• Track fixes through the backlog. Follow up on status, confirm improvements work once shipped, and flag regressions.

Documentation & Process Improvement

• Write and maintain clear review guidelines, decision criteria, and escalation paths so decisions stay consistent as the program scales.

• Find parts of the review workflow that can be automated, simplified, or removed. Help shape the internal tools the team uses.

What We Look For:

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience 

• A genuine interest in consumer fintech, rewards and loyalty programs, or how products run at scale behind the scenes

• Strong attention to detail: you notice when something's off, and you care about getting it right every time, not just most of the time

• A structured, logical mindset: you enjoy finding the pattern behind individual cases and turning it into a rule, a fix, or a recommendation

• Effective written and verbal communication: you can write a bug report an engineer can act on right away, and summarize a trend cle

We build long-term relationships with our customers, employees, and vendors through personal attention, clear communication, and respect. That’s the foundation of everything we do.
Now we are looking for Financial Controller for one of our logistics client.
The Financial Controller is the senior accounting leader for the operating business and its acquired entities. Reporting to corporate finance and partnering with operating leadership, this role manages the full accounting lifecycle, working capital, and acquisition integration.
This hands-on position ensures accurate books, timely closes, system reconciliations, disciplined cash operations, credit risk monitoring, and robust internal controls while delivering operating data to support parent-level reporting and M&A execution.
Key Responsibilities
Accounting & Close Management

• Own month-end close across multi-entity operations (preliminary financials by Business Day 7; final close by BD 10).

Systems & Reconciliations

• Reconcile operational platforms (TMS/operational software), factoring platforms, bank accounts, payroll, and the general ledger (GL).

Payables & Cash Management

Receivables, Factoring & Credit Control

Acquisition Integration & Corporate Support

• Lead accounting integration for new acquisitions (opening balances, system/bank migrations, payroll, and cut-off controls).

Team Leadership

• Lead and mentor AP, AR, and staff accounting teams.

• Establish SOPs, maintain service levels, and ensure cross-training for critical workflows.

Authority & Boundaries

• Controller Authority: Enforces accounting policies, close timelines, payment controls, and credit holds across operating entities.

• Corporate Ownership: Parent/holding company finance retains final authority over annual budgets, strategic pricing, capital allocation, M&A execution, and material credit limit exceptions.

Qualifications
Required

• Experience: 7+ years in progressive accounting, with 3+ years as Controller or Assistant Controller.

• Core Skills: Hands-on multi-entity month-end close, high-volume AP/AR management, 13-week cash forecasting, and customer credit administration.

• Technical: Strong US GAAP knowledge, internal control design, and advanced Excel.

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

Working Conditions

• Schedule: Mon-Fri, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time (Cincinnati)

• Competitive Salary in USD

title: Senior Supplier Quality Engineer, Altius
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Launched Effects team at Anduril is responsible for scaling the manufacturing and delivery of the ALTIUS family of systems (including the ALTIUS-600 and ALTIUS-700). As the premier Air-Launched Effects (ALE) platform for the U.S. military and its allies, ALTIUS is redefining modern warfare. These tube-launched, autonomous aerial systems must be built to survive extreme deployment environments, requiring precision manufacturing of advanced composites, complex avionics, and modular payload integrations for ISR, Electronic Warfare, and kinetic strike capabilities.

As part of the Launched Effects manufacturing team, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge R&D and high-rate production. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven group of manufacturing engineers, quality specialists, and production operations experts who refuse to accept traditional, slow defense manufacturing timelines. We continuously optimize our assembly lines, implement automated testing, design for manufacturing (DFM), and build resilient supply chains to deploy reliable systems to the front lines at unprecedented speed. If you want to work on a team where your production and manufacturing decisions directly impact global security, this is it.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Supply Quality Engineer, you will work inside & outside the organization to define, develop, and execute processes that deliver high quality & reliable precision machined parts used in our missile and high-speed aircraft programs. This role focuses on collaborating and driving early engagement with our design teams and suppliers to meet our quality requirements the first time. Everything comes down to clarity and action with our suppliers and partnering with them for world class results across the supply chain. The right person for this role has knowledge of manufacturing, supply management, supplier development, sub-system performance criteria, metrology, and continuous improvement. If you are someone who loves to build world-class quality processes with suppliers, work hands-on with engineering, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

This position is permanently based in Atlanta, GA, and requires candidates to temporarily relocate for a comprehensive 1-month training program in  Santa Ana, CA . To support your transition, Anduril will fully provide and cover all corporate housing, transportation, and travel accommodations during this training period. Your recruiter will discuss the logistics of this program with you in detail during the hiring process.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Partner with our design teams to support the design development process, provide design for manufacturability feedback, and help generate product data (drawings details, BOM information, and part requirements) for precision mechanical parts that lead to supplier quality success.

• Use your knowledge and expertise of machining, molding, additive manufacturing, fabrication, special processes, and inspection/measurement to support the internal Anduril design process and ideation. Provide leadership to manage technical risks, proof of concepts, prototyping, and scaling designs for volume production.

• Drive the supplier quality development processes throughout

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
WHO WE ARE

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-duckduckgo-for-mac/, Windows https://spreadprivacy.com/windows-browser-open-beta/, iOS https://spreadprivacy.com/duckduckgo-privacy-browser-ios14/, and Android https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-app-tracking-protection/, our search engine https://duckduckgo.com/, and the DuckDuckGo subscription https://duckduckgo.com/pro. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai https://duck.ai/, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-work of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

YOUR TEAM AND ROLE

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian marketing analysis, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

- Defining core growth metrics for our products and building the infrastructure to monitor trends and anomalies

- Measuring the impact of major marketing campaigns for Duck.ai http://duck.ai, translating full-funnel data into actionable decisions

- Building monitoring pipelines to detect unexpected shifts in search traffic patterns faster and more reliably

- Expanding evaluation datasets for page context understanding across complex scenarios like multi-tab browsing and content reattachment

- Improving the trigger systems that determine when AI-assisted answers surface in DuckDuckGo Search, balancing quality and our privacy-first approach

 

Our data meets rigorous privacy standards and is necessarily sparse, so you'll need to think creatively to surface actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

 

ABOUT YOU

- You have 7+ years of experience in Data Science and a track record of leading high-complexity projects from scoping to production with minimal direction.

- You can do 2 or more of the following:

- Deploy and iterate on ML in production environments

- Develop and deploy NLP solutions

- Apply knowledge of LLMs including fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge, and AI-assisted development

- Conduct marketing campaign analysis using Bayesian methods

- You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language.

- You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills, familiarity with columnar databases like BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or Druid; experience with a BI tool like Tableau or PowerBI is a plus.

- You can design, implement, and analyze experiments across product surfaces, and are comfortable deriving insights from sparse or privacy-constrained data.

- You collaborate effectively with product teams and contribute to overall team throughput.

COMPENSATION

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

Linro enforces intended state across the whole lifecycle instead, from commit to runtime: MCP and pre-commit hooks at commit time, blast-radius simulation that blocks bad changes before they ship, and real-time detection, enforcement and auto-remediation in production. description:

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Location: UK (occasional travel to data centre and test environments, confirm exact cadence) | Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent | Reports to: VP Information Security

We're looking for a Principal/ Staff Security Engineer to join Infosec, reporting to our VP InfoSec. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will need a deep, technical understanding of Kubernetes clusters, network architecture and access controls to manage our production environment.

As we move toward owning and operating more of our own data centre footprint, the accuracy of our firewall policies, network access controls and technical security testing matters more than ever. This role will build our internal penetration testing capability, so testing becomes more targeted and accurate over time, working alongside our external testers rather than replacing them. You will need to work proactively across engineering teams so knowledge does not sit with one person alone.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

SECURITY TESTING & AUDIT:

- Audit firewall policies and network access controls across the estate.

- Conduct internal penetration testing, working alongside our external penetration testing partners.

- Build a penetration testing strategy and cadence that improves accuracy and coverage over time.

- Identify and help remediate security gaps found through testing and audit.

PRODUCTION ESTATE & TECHNICAL DEPTH:

- Build and maintain a deep, working understanding of our production environment, including Kubernetes clusters, network architecture and access controls.

- Investigate technical issues directly and dig into root cause, rather than relying on reported findings alone.

- Support the VP Infosec on controls testing across the Production Estate.

ACCESS & ENVIRONMENT MANAGEMENT:

- Own and maintain SSO and systems access configuration.

- Build and maintain penetration testing environments, including small Kubernetes clusters as needed.

- Maintain the tooling and infrastructure supporting security testing.

COLLABORATION:

- Work proactively across engineering teams to avoid becoming a single point of knowledge or failure.

- Document processes, findings and configurations so knowledge is shared, not siloed.

- Partner with the Head of Security Operations on shared governance, risk reporting and security testing.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Strong Kubernetes experience, with the technical depth to investigate and resolve issues directly.

- Experience auditing firewall policies and network access controls.

- Experience conducting or coordinating penetration testing.

- Comfortable maintaining and operating security tooling and environments on an ongoing basis.

- Strong written communication skills, given the solo nature

title: Data Product Owner
description:
Marathon Health is a leading advanced primary care provider, partnering with employer and union plan sponsors to improve health for millions of Americans. With nationwide onsite, nearsite, and network health centers, and virtual primary care, Marathon delivers a value-based model that enhances the healthcare experience for members and providers, while driving meaningful cost savings for plan sponsors. Marathon is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work®, reflecting the company's commitment to building an inclusive, high-trust culture where all employees can thrive. Learn more at
ABOUT THE JOB
The Data Product Owner leads several cross-functional scrum teams responsible for delivering outcome-based data solutions to the business. This role is defined by the problems it solves , not the technology it uses. Whether the right answer is a Tableau dashboard, a Snowflake Cortex agent, a Python-based insight package delivered as a Streamlit portal, or a reusable component of our semantic model, the Data Product Owner is accountable for choosing the approach that best achieves the desired outcome and for guiding their teams to build it.

Our stakeholders are primarily internal, though some solutions serve external audiences, and their needs evolve quickly. This person must be comfortable operating in an environment where both Technology and Product direction change, treating that change as a normal condition rather than a disruption. A major part of the mandate is enablement: building the foundational pieces - starting with a well-structured semantic model - that let stakeholders and teams across the organization build their own solutions, inside and outside of Technology. The ideal candidate is fluent in leveraging AI to accelerate how these solutions get designed, built, and maintained.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the product vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for a portfolio of outcome-based data solutions serving internal and external stakeholders.

• Lead multiple scrum teams day to day - including backlog grooming, sprint planning, prioritization, and removing blockers - while keeping teams focused on measurable outcomes over outputs.

• Take direction from the Director of Business Intelligence on analytics and reporting outcomes, and from the Technical Product Manager on technical and product execution, reconciling their input into a single prioritized backlog.

• Proactively surface conflicts in priority or direction early, and drive them to resolution rather than letting teams stall.

• Translate stakeholder goals into clearly defined problems, success metrics, and acceptance criteria, and validate that delivered solutions actually move those metrics.

• Select the right delivery approach for each problem (e.g., Tableau, Snowflake / Cortex agents, Python / Streamlit portals) based on the outcome and the audience, rather than defaulting to a preferred technology or pattern.

• Leverage AI and modern tooling to accelerate discovery, prototyping, development, and iteration across the teams.

• Build and steward foundational, reusable components - especially the semantic model - so that stakeholders and other teams can reliably build their own solutions against a trusted, governed layer.

• Establish and support self-service enablement, including documentation, patterns, and guardrails, so users can create their own solutions with confidence.

• Partner closely with Product leaders and internal stakeholders who depend on these solutions, keeping all parties aligned on priorities, tradeoffs, and delivery status.

• Anticipate and absorb change from both Technology and Product, adjusting priorities and communicating impacts without losing delivery momentum.

• Ensure solutions meet quality, security, and compliance expectations appropriate to internal and external use.

• Track adoption, usage, and business impact, and use those insights to continuously refine the portfolio.

description:

This role combines patient access and reimbursement expertise with a pharmacy technician background and to identify and address barriers related to coverage, authorization, prescription processing, pharmacy coordination, affordability, and fulfillment.
Candidates must hold an active Pharmacy Technician license in their state of residence
AND
Be willing and able to obtain a Texas Pharmacy Technician license

The role provides guidance and support throughout the access journey, helping ensure prescriptions and required documentation move efficiently through benefit verification, prior authorization, pharmacy processing, and treatment initiation.

• Provide education and guidance to provider offices regarding program processes, prescription requirements, coverage considerations, required documentation, and available patient support resources.

• Communicate case status, outstanding requirements, next steps, and barriers clearly and accurately to appropriate stakeholders.

• Effectively manage and prioritize competing demands, including insurance approval timelines, prescription processing requirements, patient treatment schedules, pharmacy timelines, and stakeholder communications.

title: AI & Marketing Automation Lead
description:
ThreeTrader is looking for a hands-on AI & Marketing Automation Lead to design, build and continuously improve the AI and automation systems behind our marketing - across acquisition, content production, campaigns, client nurturing and analytics.
By connecting AI, our CRM, ad platforms and internal data, you will cut repetitive manual work, raise marketing efficiency and deliver measurable commercial results. Over time, you will build a scalable, semi-automated marketing function.
This is a builder-leader role. You will own process design, tool selection, delivery and team enablement - and you will be expected to implement, not just advise.
Key responsibilities
1. Set the marketing automation roadmap

• Map current marketing processes, roles, tools and data sources, and identify where automation will pay off most.

• Build 90-day and 12-month implementation plans, prioritised by business value, effort and risk.

• Define which tasks AI performs, which require human review, and how exceptions are handled.

2. Build AI-powered marketing workflows

• Create end-to-end workflows from brief and market research through drafting, asset production, review, publishing and performance review.

• Support production and iteration of ad copy, email, landing pages, social content and Japanese-market content.

• Build a brand knowledge base, content templates and quality checks so output is accurate and on-brand.

• Make successful workflows reusable across the team, reducing reliance on any one person's know-how.

3. Integrate CRM and the client journey

• Connect HubSpot, the client portal, ad platforms, website events and other business data.

• Optimise journeys across registration, identity verification, first deposit, activation, retention and win-back.

• Protect existing segments, journeys and historical records when systems or data integrations change.

• Build deduplication, retries, logging, monitoring and alerting so automations run reliably.

4. Build analytics and optimisation capability

• Align event definitions, lifecycle stages and marketing metrics with the marketing and engineering teams.

• Automate channel and campaign reporting, flag data anomalies and recommend improvements.

• Enable conversion and CAC analysis by channel, campaign and client segment.

• Run before-and-after evaluations on every automation to prove hours saved and business impact.

5. Drive AI adoption across the team

• Create clear playbooks, review standards and training materials for each role.

• Help marketers build AI into their daily work and keep improving results.

• Manage tools, vendors and implementation resources, keeping cost and system complexity in check.

• Work with Marketing, Engineering and Compliance to govern client data access and publishing permissions.

Requirements
What you'll bring

• 7+ years in Marketing Operations, Growth Engineering, CRM, marketing automation or systems integration.

• 2+ years applying generative AI to real business workflows, with live examples you can show.

• Led at least two cross-system automation projects end to end - requirements, build, launch and ongoing maintenance.

• Strong grasp of the marketing funnel and how registration, verification, first deposit, activation and retention connect.

• Hands-on HubSpot (or comparable CRM) implementation experience: workflows, properties, segmentation and event triggers.

title: Jr Controllership Analyst - Brazil
description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the backbone to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

The Role
As a Junior Controllership Analyst, you will be part of the team that ensures the quality of ARQ’s accounting and financial information across multiple geographies, with an initial focus on Brazil. With support and mentorship from the senior team and local controllers, you will take part in day-to-day accounting and the monthly close, reconciliations, and regulatory reporting, learning first-hand how a regulated fintech operates at scale and across different jurisdictions. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to grow fast in a highly complex environment, with international exposure and constant learning.

What you’ll be doing

- Journal Entries & Month-End Close: Prepare journal entries and support the monthly close of the group’s entities across more than one geography, following the calendar and routines defined by the team.

- Reconciliations: Perform bank, general ledger, and customer balance reconciliations, identifying differences and supporting the investigation and resolution of open items.

- Regulatory Reporting: Support the preparation and validation of documents and reports to local regulators (such as CADOCs to the Central Bank in Brazil), together with the senior team.

- Financial Statements: Support the preparation of trial balances and financial statements for the group’s entities, including notes to the financial statements, and assist with requests from the local external audits and the consolidated audit.

- Tax Obligations & Intercompany: Support accounting-to-tax reconciliations, tax and withholding tracking, and the recording of intercompany transactions between group entities.

- Local Accounting Standards & Consolidation: Support the understanding of differences between each country’s accounting practices (such as Brazilian GAAP/CPC, US GAAP, and IFRS) and the preparation of information for the group consolidation.

- Process Improvement: Help document routines and identify automation opportunities, working with Finance, Product, and Data.

What you’ll need

- Degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field (final year or completed)

- 1 to 2 years of experience in accounting or controllership (internships count)

- Basic knowledge of statutory accounting and Brazilian accounting practices (CPC)

- Intermediate Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, reconciliations)

- Organization, attention to detail, and commitment to deadlines

- Eagerness to learn and to work at a fast pace

- Intermediate English

Nice-to-haves

- Experience in a financial institution, fintech, consulting, or audit

- Familiarity with COSIF, CADOC, and Central Bank regulation

- Familiarity with US GAAP, IFRS, or accounting in other Latin American countries

- Familiarity with accounting ERPs and data tools (SQL, Power BI)

- Knowledge of payments, FX, or digital asset products

- Postgraduate degree, MBA, or certifications in progress (CRC, IFRS)

We track 10M+ listings in 120,000 markets, and our platform is trusted by users in over 100 countries. It’s big data, made useful.
The AirDNA team
